name: Dreambox Malacca
detail: The location is great, you can walk to Chicken Soup Street and nearby attractions, and it takes basically 15 minutes by taxi to get to the station or other places. It's very quiet, probably because it's the off-season; in a room for four, there are only two people staying, and having a private bathroom is very convenient, it's like staying in a girls' dormitory. I really like the bed; it's not too soft and very comfortable to sleep in. Overall, I highly recommend it.

name: Sunday Malacca Near Jonker Street Formerly Quayside
detail: I am very satisfied with my 3 days and 2 nights stay at Quayside Hotel Melaka! We took a River View room - the view is really beautiful at night with the lights of the Melaka River, and the kids were excited to see the River Cruise boats passing by. The location is definitely 10/10, right next to the Water Wheel, it’s just a short walk to Jonker Street, Stadthuys & Museum. It’s easy to take little ones out without needing to drive. The room was clean, the bed was comfortable, and the air conditioner was cool. The front desk staff were very friendly and helpful. It’s truly value for money with such a prime location. Perfect for a family trip. Thank you Quayside Hotel, God willing I will visit again! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

name: Vspace Guesthouse Capsule & Cafe
detail: Sumpah best Staff ramah Bilik selesa Tandas banyak atas and bawah Location pon best dekat dgn semua benda

name: The Pines by Amanjiwa
detail: It was a hotel with a dungeon-like feel, such as receiving the key away from the hotel entrance. The location didn't have any restaurants or shops nearby, but since taxis are cheap in Malaysia, it wasn't much of a problem. The room was very clean, spacious, and I was able to use the hotel pool (just make sure to bring your own towel), making for a comfortable stay.

name: Hatten Hotel Melaka
detail: Overall, I am very satisfied with my stay at this hotel. The check-in and check-out process went smoothly with the help of very friendly and professional staff. The cleanliness of the room was at its best, the mattress was very soft, and the room space felt spacious and comfortable. The breakfast menu also offered a variety of delicious local and international dishes. The hotel's location is very strategic as it is close to various amenities and attractions. I will definitely return in the future!

name: HEEREN BY THE RIVER HOTEL
detail: In the early morning, there are no staff available, so I was uncertain about what to do during check-in and check-out. The facilities are relatively clean. The John Car Street Night Market is very close, making it perfect for food strolling.

name: Yote 28
detail: ⭐️ This is the best hostel experience I've had on this trip, and I would recommend it to every friend going to Malacca. 1️⃣ Price: Approximately 85 per night booked through Agoda, no deposit required. Just leave the room card at the front desk when checking out, and the front desk staff speaks Chinese. 2️⃣ Location: The hostel is at the end of a somewhat desolate main road, but it is brightly lit at night so there’s no need to worry. It takes about ten minutes to walk to the Dutch Red House, and most popular attractions are nearby; a taxi will take around ten minutes. It costs about RM10 by taxi to Malacca Central Station, or you can take the F100 bus to Dutch Square and then walk (Malacca buses do not give change, so please prepare small change). 2️⃣ Environment — Common area: The second floor is for male dorms, and the third floor is for female dorms. The common area is quite large, the front desk has a small bar where you can buy some beer, there are three tables and a large dining table, as well as a multimedia room; there are also three little cats. — Dorm environment: The female dorm has eight beds, you can adjust the air conditioning yourself, the beds have a tatami design, and there are lockable cabinets; the door card has a loud unlocking sound, and if you close the curtains, if the lights are on inside, it is very clear outside. — Washing environment: Towels are not provided, the public bathrooms are outside the dorms, and the bathing rooms are separate, very clean and they thoughtfully provide items like makeup remover wipes. — Basic facilities: Free drinking water, snacks, coffee, and tea bags are provided, and there is a back door where you can hang your clothes to dry. — Cleanliness: You need to take off your shoes upstairs, and the overall cleanliness is excellent. 4️⃣ Nearby food: The nearest restaurants are almost all Indian restaurants, and there are several food stalls at night. There is also a square nearby where you can find food, and McDonald's is not far away.

name: Dusit Princess Melaka
detail: Location It was close to the Malacca River, walkable, and I really liked the surrounding restaurants. Breakfast Since I visited early in the morning, I was able to try various types during the quiet hours. Service I received RM50 dining tickets for each night of my stay, which I used to buy fresh juice and cookies in the evening, allowing me to use the café without paying extra. When I returned in the evening, the cleaning had not yet been done, but they responded immediately when I inquired. All the staff were friendly. Parking When I informed the front desk of my car number when leaving, I was able to use it for free. Pool Clean bath towels were provided. The pool depth varied from 0.6m to 2.7m, which was enjoyable. One concern There was a smell of cigarettes from somewhere, and I wasn't sure if it was from the neighboring room, but I thought the room was non-smoking, so that was a downside. Despite the very reasonable price, the experience was very fulfilling, so I definitely want to use it again.

name: The Backpackers Hut Jonker Melaka
detail: This room is very comfortable and private, all the amenities are good, the air conditioning is cool, and the bathroom and space in the room are clean and very comfortable.
